visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border with #E6DDD1 to ground soft shadows
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for panels and large cards, rounded-xl for product cards, rounded-full for primary action buttons

grids.products_area: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4
grids.cart_area: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 sticky top-6 h-[calc(100vh-3rem)] flex flex-col bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-[#E6DDD1]

layouts.login: flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen bg-[#F9F6F0] p-4
layouts.navigation: flex items-center space-x-2 p-4 bg-white border-b border-[#E6DDD1] sticky top-0 z-50

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #2C1F16 on #F9F6F0 meets APCA standards. Use #FFFFFF text on #C8664D and #768962 buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a POS application for 'REAL COFFEE ADİSYON' in Turkish.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for standard POS icons (tables, products, settings, cart).
Implement Shadcn/UI for tables, dialogs, dropdowns, and toast (sonner).
Avoid Vercel-like tech styling; apply custom colors (#F9F6F0 bg, #2C1F16 text, #C8664D accents) to all Shadcn components.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components.
For the POS order screen, use the Bento layout defined in grids. Left side for category tabs and product cards. Right side for Adisyon (Cart).
Sıcak İçecekler (Hot Drinks) must have 3 sizes: Tall, Grande, Venti (each with different prices). Create a custom dialog or inline selector for these sizes when clicking the product.
Soğuk İçecekler (Cold Drinks) and Diğer Ürünler (Other) have a single size/price.
Currency is TL (₺). Format numbers accordingly.
Order panel must have an 'Öde' (Pay) button that triggers a browser print window (`window.print()`).
Ensure the Dashboard view displays Daily and Monthly total sales as large cards (Neumorphic tactile look) and lists sold products.
Provide management screens for Products (add/edit/delete, update prices) and Tables (add/delete).
Implement a simple password login screen with the provided background image.
Use Sonner for all success/error notifications (e.g., 'Ürün eklendi', 'Masa silindi').
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Left-align text inputs and labels.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and warm shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Apply specific transitions like transition-colors, transition-transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-full for primary POS actions).
NEVER use emoji characters like 🤖 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Make touch targets large.
Provide empty states with clear CTAs when tables or products are empty.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
The codebase uses .js files, not .tsx. Adjust Shadcn component imports and configurations accordingly.
Use light theme by default for better daytime legibility.
